title: Sr. MLOps Engineer
description:

title: Technical Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide application and production support for Mobile Money, e\-Wallet, Prepaid Recharge, Credit Card Payment, and related digital payment platforms.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve application, database, network, and infrastructure issues within defined SLAs.
* Ensure timely categorization, tracking, updates, and closure of incidents, service requests, and problem tickets.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and prepare detailed 5\-Why RCA reports for recurring and critical issues.
* Implement configuration changes, patches, and fixes to address customer requirements and production issues.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, Method of Procedure (MOP) documents, and activity reports.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure system stability, availability, and performance.
* Support planned maintenance activities, deployments, upgrades, and release implementations.
* Monitor application and infrastructure health using NMS and monitoring tools.
* Participate in 24x7 support operations and major incident management activities.
* Work closely with customers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure effective communication and issue resolution.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Knowledge of Mobile Money, e\-Wallet, Prepaid Recharge, Credit Card Payment, or similar digital payment solutions.
* Hands\-on experience in application support and production support environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Database (PL/SQL and Administration), PostgreSQL, JDK/JRE, Linux (RHEL/OEL), and Tomcat or other web application servers.
* Good understanding of operating systems, applications, networking concepts, and interface troubleshooting.
* Experience in incident management, problem management, and SLA\-based support processes.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and prepare structured RCA documentation.
* Familiarity with hardware components such as servers, storage systems, switches, and load balancers.
* Experience working with monitoring tools such as Nagios and ticketing systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination, stakeholder management, and teamwork abilities.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast\-paced technical environment.
* Positive, flexible, and customer\-focused attitude with willingness to work in 24x7 support operations.


**Desirable Skills**
* Knowledge of messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ.
* Understanding of Microservices Architecture and distributed systems.
* Experience with Business Intelligence platforms such as Pentaho.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS and Microsoft Azure.
* CCNA, RHCE, or equivalent industry certifications.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications in highly available and mission\-critical environments.
* Exposure to release management, patch management, and infrastructure operations.

 Requirements

- Understanding of Networking (DNS, HTTP, IP, SSH)

- Git \& Version Control

- CI/CD Concepts

- Bash/Shell or Python Scripting

- Problem\-Solving and Troubleshooting Skills
